patterns.name: unexpected_admin_membership
patterns.condition: T1078 and high severity: ordinary account added to administrators, especially remotely or in bulk
patterns.evidence: T1078 covers misuse of valid accounts and unexpected privileged account access.

patterns.name: unexpected_privileged_command
patterns.condition: T1068 and high severity: first-seen source, another identity, or newly elevated account runs privileged command
patterns.evidence: T1068 describes privilege escalation; anomalous privileged command use warrants isolation review.

patterns.name: admin_session_escalation
patterns.condition: T1068 high severity: session unexpectedly becomes administrative from previously unseen source
patterns.evidence: Unexpected elevation of an authenticated session can enable privilege escalation.

patterns.name: weak_privilege_indicator
patterns.condition: T1068 or T1078 with low-to-medium severity and unconfirmed or isolated permission activity
patterns.evidence: Isolated group changes and failed privilege prompts can be legitimate; notify before blocking.
